title: Warring out, Pargat in: Has Congress solved Punjab crisis or set stage for another twist?
content: Amarinder Singh Raja Warring has resigned as the president of the Punjab Congress after more than four years. His resignation follows a prolonged period of infighting over leadership roles within the party. Both Charanjit Singh Channi and Warring have seen shifts in their status amid ongoing power struggles.  But has Congress really solved the Punjab crisis?

title: Akhilesh's Rajya Sabha picks: SP's master strategy or 'PDA' contradiction?
content: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav's Rajya Sabha picks, including uncle Ram Gopal Yadav and Reliance executive Dhanraj Parimal Nathwani, are being seen as an early test for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly polls. The nominations raise questions over the SP's PDA strategy, its broader political outreach and a possible third Rajya Sabha candidate, despite the party's numbers falling short of the winning quota.

title: AI and the monk: Anthropic goes for swami and friends to tame Claude
content: Anthropic engaged various religious scholars and philosophers to explore ethical frameworks for advanced AI development. The discussions included considerations about potential moral status and consciousness in AI like Claude. Participants included Swami Sarvapriyananda, who has addressed the distinctions between intelligence and consciousness. The aim is to incorporate values from multiple faith traditions into AI training processes.

title: Mohsin Naqvi to skip India-Pak Asian Games gold medal match due to 'prior commitments'
content: The ACC confirmed that Naqvi will miss the final at Korogi Park because of "prior commitments". India and Pakistan will meet for the gold medal after Sri Lanka and Bangladesh play the bronze-medal match.

title: SIR under review: Former SC, HC judges to examine 'validity' of voter roll revision
content: A panel of five former judges is being formed to review the Election Commission's Special Intensive Revision. The Lawyers Association for Constitution emphasizes the panel's independence in assessing the review's validity and impact. Senior lawyers are expected to provide strategic legal advice to the panel throughout the process. The Election Commission has also initiated a drive to identify and re-enrol excluded eligible voters.

title: MacKenzie Scott gave $30m to housing nonprofit; a year later, it unveiled 10-year plan
content: In October 2024, MacKenzie Scott made headlines by donating $30 million to Housing Trust Silicon Valley via her Yield Giving fund. This substantial contribution will support various housing initiatives over the next decade, particularly focusing on enhancing homeownership assistance. Housing Trust has a successful track record, having already developed thousands of affordable homes in the Bay Area.

title: Maryland homeowner gets $234,368 check for home; new law bans such offers
content: Effective October 1, Maryland introduced legislation banning unsolicited checks sent with home purchase offers. This initiative is designed to safeguard homeowners from misleading marketing strategies from property investors. Consumer advocates highlighted the risk of vulnerable owners being tricked into agreements upon receiving such checks. Historical precedents in consumer lending underline the necessity for legal protections, advising homeowners against accepting random financial items received through mail.

title: Father got 3 bigha in 1972; HC protects married daughter's land claim
content: In 1972, the Himachal Pradesh government allotted three bigha and two biswas of agricultural land in Shimla to a person under the Nautor rules for cultivation.  His wife died in 2012, leaving behind their only daughter, who subsequently approached the revenue authorities once again for issuance of the patta. Her request was reportedly rejected outright on the ground that married daughters were ineligible for land under the Nautor rules.

title: Assam nightclub horror: Woman stripped, kicked on floor; manager detained
content: A woman was allegedly stripped and assaulted in a nightclub located in Khanapara, Guwahati. The incident reportedly involved bouncers, and videos show the woman's distressing situation. The nightclub's manager has been detained for questioning following the event. Police officials confirmed that they will take legal action after investigating the case. The identity of the victim remains unknown as authorities continue to gather information.

title: Mississippi ‘Taj Mahal’ waterfront home returns to market for $2.5 million
content: A $2.5 million unfinished mansion inspired by the Taj Mahal is now available in Ocean Springs, Mississippi. Dr. Pravin Saija began construction in 2008, but delays due to contractor issues have slowed down the project. Completing the mansion will require an estimated $800,000 to $1.2 million for utilities, interior fittings, and landscaping. Marketing highlights renderings of the envisioned spaces, targeting buyers interested in unique residential or commercial possibilities.

title: Florida approves $72.6m to protect 10,770 acres across the state
content: An ambitious architectural project reminiscent of the Taj Mahal awaits a new owner in Ocean Springs, Mississippi. Once priced at $2 million in 2016, the unfinished mansion is now listed for $2.5 million. Encompassing 4,402 square feet, the estate is a blank canvas requiring extensive renovations. With building permits acquired back in 2008, progress has halted. The current seller hopes a visionary buyer can finally realize this home's potential.

title: Six years after his $10 billion climate pledge, Jeff Bezos turns to the Pacific Ocean
content: Jeff Bezos’ Earth Fund has announced more than $25 million in new ocean conservation grants across five Pacific nations. The funding will support marine protection and sustainable management across more than 625,000 square miles. The latest awards bring the fund’s Pacific commitment to $63.3 million of its planned $100 million.

title: Utah removes 17 million tons of radioactive waste from beside Colorado River
content: The Moab Uranium Mill Tailings Remedial Action Project has efficiently relocated 17 million tons of waste from the riverbank. Following rail transportation, teams are actively monitoring groundwater contamination levels. Upcoming efforts will also involve excavating contaminated soil near the original tailings site. The objective is to guarantee long-term safety and stability for local residents and the ecosystem. Ultimately, regrading and revegetating the area will be crucial in preventing future erosion.

title: Israeli investigators to question Omani co-pilot in UAE-led flydubai probe: Report
content: Israeli investigators are expected to question the Omani co-pilot involved in the flight attack incident. The investigation is led by UAE authorities to determine the motives and background of the co-pilot. The attack occurred during flydubai flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv, resulting in an emergency landing. The Indian captain was stabbed but managed to regain control and land safely.

title: Rahul demands CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation as protests erupt in Delhi, Mumbai
content: Rahul Gandhi has called for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation during ongoing protests. These protests arose over allegations of irregularities in the electoral-roll revision exercise. Approximately 700 protesters were detained in Delhi while trying to gather near Jantar Mantar for the demonstrations. Additional protests took place in Mumbai, where various groups demanded Kumar's resignation and accountability.

title: Justin Gaethje’s Topuria win sparks Joe Rogan’s bold UFC legacy claim
content: Joe Rogan believes Justin Gaethje could retire as one of MMA’s all time greats after defeating Ilia Topuria at UFC Freedom 250. Gaethje won the undisputed lightweight title at the White House after a fourth round corner stoppage. The victory completed a major part of his career, leaving him with the choice of defending his title or walking away.

title: Can Jared Goff pass Joe Montana this week? Lions QB needs just 128 yards
content: Jared Goff enters the Detroit Lions’ Week 4 matchup against the Carolina Panthers just 128 passing yards away from moving ahead of Joe Montana on the NFL’s career list. With Carolina missing starting cornerbacks Jaycee Horn and Mike Jackson, Goff has a clear opportunity to reach the milestone on Sunday Night Football.

title: Kohli will fall short of Sachin's 100-century record: Ex-cricketer's bold prediction
content: Tendulkar played 664 international matches across formats between 1989 and 2013. He scored 100 centuries, including 51 in 200 Tests and 49 in 463 ODIs.

title: ‘Workers growing increasingly anxious’: US adds 29k jobs, far below 90k expected
content: US employers added only 29,000 jobs in September, significantly lower than economists' expectations of 90,000. The unemployment rate rose to 4.2% as more people entered the workforce without immediate jobs. Healthcare hiring showed a notable slowdown, with government job cuts further contributing to weak hiring figures. While layoffs decreased by 18%, hiring plans fell sharply, reaching their lowest since 2011.

title: From software engineer to $100-an-hour mehndi artist: How a woman turned childhood art into a side hustle
content: Priyancka Jaiin reveals how her childhood love for mehndi has blossomed into a lucrative side hustle. While maintaining her career as a software engineer, she serves clients with mehndi designs for a variety of events. Her artistry not only brings joy to brides but also supports cancer patients and mothers-to-be. Emphasizing careful practice, Jaiin showcases that a simple hobby can evolve into a significant source of creativity and fulfillment.

title: Meet Madurai’s ‘pen doctor’ keeping a 55-year-old trade alive
content: In Madurai, an elderly craftsman continues to run his pen repair shop, even as the number of customers dwindles. Positioned near the East Gate of the iconic Meenakshi Amman Temple, he dedicates his days to this trade. While digital tools dominate the market, schoolchildren still seek pens for their studies. His unwavering commitment to his craft reflects the resilience of traditional trades amidst modern transformations.

title: Six gold medals across boxing, wrestling, hockey highlight Asian Games Day 13
content: India produced a stunning six-gold haul on the penultimate day of the Asian Games on Friday, with the women's hockey team, three boxers, archers and wrestler Sujeet Kalkal leading a late surge that took the country into the top five of the medal table. India moved to fifth place with 76 medals - 16 gold, 25 silver and 35 bronze. India have more medals than fourth-placed Uzbekistan, who have 65, but trail them by four gold medals.

title: 'May Bapu’s timeless message keep guiding us': PM Modi pays tribute to Mahatma Gandhi
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi participated in a special interfaith prayer meeting to honor Mahatma Gandhi's birth anniversary. He paid floral tributes at Gandhi Smriti and Rajghat earlier in the day. PM Modi emphasized Gandhi's ideals of truth, peace, and non-violence while urging people to adopt Swadeshi. Vice President CP Radhakrishnan also attended and remembered Gandhi's contributions to India's freedom movement.

title: India clinch first women's hockey gold since 1982 at Asiad; seal LA28 Olympics spot
content: It was the women's hockey team's first medal at the continental event since winning their only gold in 1982. India ended a 44-year wait with the win over defending champions China and also secured direct qualification for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

title: ‘Sometimes there are blind spots’: Nihal Sarin looks back at Chess Olympiad loss
content: Welcome to the third instalment of TimesofIndia.com's interview series looking back at India's medal-winning campaigns at the Chess Olympiad in Samarkand. After speaking to the two captains of the open and women's teams, we turn to Nihal Sarin, who clinched a silver medal with the open team. In an exclusive interaction, the 22-year-old looks back on the painful loss to eventual champions Uzbekistan, his miss, the memories he takes away from this Olympiad, and much more.

title: Tom Brady's TB12 habits explain why he stayed elite long after most QBs retired
content: Tom Brady's illustrious 23-season NFL career came to a close at the age of 45, showcasing his remarkable commitment to athletic performance. His TB12 method promoted concepts such as muscle pliability, a plant-based diet, hydration, and quality sleep. With his efficient playing style, notable for quick decisions and ball release, he minimized injuries. Fans can embrace aspects of Brady's routine that enhance health without breaking the bank.

content: Jayden Daniels, the Washington Commander’s star quarterback, has been dealing with a tough injury in his left elbow ahead of Week 4.

title: Asian Games Medal Tally: Historic hockey, wrestling golds power India into top 5
content: India now have 16 gold, 25 silver and 35 bronze medals, taking their overall tally to 76 medals. They are currently fifth in the standings, behind China, Japan, South Korea and Uzbekistan. China continue to lead the medal table with 162 gold, 81 silver and 73 bronze medals, for a total of 316 medals. Japan are second with 71 golds, 83 silvers and 85 bronzes, while South Korea are third with 33 golds, 39 silvers and 62 bronzes.

title: California girl opened lemonade stand at 8, raised over $100,000 in 6 months
content: Vivienne Harr, a remarkable eight-year-old from Fairfax, California, turned a childhood lemonade stand into a beacon of hope against child slavery. Inspired by a chilling image depicting the plight of enslaved children, she aimed to raise $100,000. Upon hitting her target, her dedication didn’t waver; she spent an entire year expanding her mission, creating organic bottled beverages that now support various charities.

title: Ohio man allegedly took $3m from investors for fake ticket scheme
content: An Ohio man pleaded guilty to running a fake investment scheme that prosecutors say defrauded five victims in Ohio and Florida of more than $3 million. John E. Brown II promoted supposed “rolling code ticket packages” linked to sports and theme-park experiences, but the investment did not exist. Prosecutors said he used investors’ money for personal expenses, including about $1.375 million in casino transfers.

title: US job growth slows sharply in September, unemployment rate rises to 4.2%
content: The US job market showed signs of struggle in September, with a mere 29,000 jobs being added and unemployment rising to 4.2 percent. This news surprised analysts and led to corrections in past employment figures. Despite steady employment in sectors like healthcare and construction, the increase in average hourly earnings to 3.0% provided little comfort.

title: Kevin O’Leary-backed Utah AI data center plan downsized after local backlash
content: Kevin O’Leary-backed plans for a 40,000-acre AI data centre district in Utah have been cut to about 20,000 acres after strong local opposition. Residents have raised concerns over the project’s energy and water use, environmental impact and public review. Developers say the project could create thousands of jobs and support US computing and national defence.

title: 'No mental capacity to react': Flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar's wife recalls shock
content: Sonal Machchhar faced an emotional turmoil upon discovering her husband Captain Smit Machchhar's heroic efforts during an airborne incident on a flydubai flight. Initially overwhelmed by the news, she found solace after visiting him in the hospital, reassured by his professional handling of the attack and the safety he ensured for the passengers. The incident has sparked an ongoing investigation involving both Israeli and UAE authorities.

title: The Rashtriya Rifles: The temporary force that stayed 36 years

As a Group Business Head at Times Internet Limited, I spend my days growing a newsroom I once belonged to. I live at the edge of the newsroom now; close enough to hear the first draft of history, far enough to question it. I write occasionally on experiences and things that stay with me. title: Congress appoints Aradhana Misra as UP chief, names Imran Masood working president
content:
Congress appoints Aradhana Misra Mona as UPCC chief

NEW DELHI: The Congress on Friday appointed Aradhana Misra Mona as the president of the Uttar Pradesh Congress Committee (UPCC), replacing Ajay Rai. The party also named MP Imran Masood as working president of the state unit, with the appointments taking immediate effect. The Congress approved the appointment of Chaudhary Virendra Singh as the leader of the Congress Legislature Party (CLP) in Uttar Pradesh. Devinder Nishad and Alok Prasad have been appointed senior vice presidents of the state unit. In a separate organisational change, the party appointed Pargat Singh as the president of the Punjab Pradesh Congress Committee (PPCC), with immediate effect. The appointment comes after Amarinder Singh Raja Warring stepped down as Punjab Congress chief.Also read - 2027 polls: Cong names Pargat Singh as Punjab prez after Warring's resignation The appointments were announced through a party statement.
